infra-alert-bot: [ALERT] apac-gpu-pool-1 util=93% sustained 5m, queue_depth=628 (+540% 10m). Top models: gpt-large-ephemeral, mpt-serve-7B
Maya: seeing same in Grafana, looks like two AZs showing degraded node count (az1/az2). rate-limit at ingress kicked in, but queue still growing.
Ethan: I pulled pprof traces, KV cache miss rate spiked. suspect frequent preemptions + network blips causing pod churn.
Lina: can we soft-throttle best-effort customers? propose per-model admission policy: 60% L1 (priority) tokens, 40% best-effort.
Carter: FYI spinning new nodes in APAC will cost ~$7k/day, but prevents tail latency SLO violations. Thoughts?
Maya: quick diagnostic — run `kubectl get pods -n redwood-apac -o wide | grep gpu` and `rctl adm list --region apac --sort=queue`.
oncall-sre: ran `rctl adm list --region apac --sort=queue` output:
```
model gpt-large-ephemeral queue=312 running=120 preemptions=18
model mpt-serve-7B queue=210 running=90 preemptions=12
model rerank-v1 queue=106 running=8 preemptions=4
```
Maya: that's helpful. gpt-large is hogging active slots. Suggest two-prong: 1) enable soft-throttle on gpt-large at 30rps per-tenant, 2) increase eviction grace window from 30s->90s to reduce churn, 3) trigger emergency scale + warm nodes (if billing approved).
Ethan: implemented soft-throttle script to apiserver: `POST /admin/ratelimit` payload deployed to canary apis — monitoring now.
Lina: started canary for tenant-tiering: priority customers cut to 75% of prior concurrency, best-effort to 25%. Notifying execs.
Carter: finance approves temporary scale for 12h with cost cap. I'll kick off node pool resize + set auto-rollback.
oncall-sre: after throttle + eviction tweak queue dropped to 240 in 8m. tail latency improved from 420ms -> 220ms.
Maya: good. action items: (1) leave soft-throttle for 6h, (2) follow-up with infra to root cause network flaps in AZ, (3) schedule model profile to reduce gpt-large memory (quantize) for longer term.
Ethan: opening incident ticket INV-APAC-193501 on jira, linking logs and pprof.
Lina: pinging sales for impacted customers list.
Maya: closing thread for now — we'll monitor next hour. :white_check_mark:
